angle_en: All classes of beings are astonished

en.intro: Arjuna is still staring at the cosmic form. Listen to every class of being he names, and notice who is looking and who is not.
en.notice: The word vispmitah means astonished. Even the highest beings, from Rudras to Asuras, are left staring in wonder at Krishna, unable to look away.
en.next: Arjuna then admits that he himself is shaken by the many mouths and terrible fangs he sees in the vision.
en.meaning: The eleven Rudras, the twelve Adityas, the eight Vasus, the twelve Sadhyas, the Visvedevas, the two Ashvins, the forty-nine Maruts, the ancestors, and the hosts of Gandharvas, Yakshas, Asuras, and Siddhas all gaze at you in wonder.

hi.intro: अर्जुन अभी भी उस विशाल रूप को देख रहे हैं। उन सभी वर्गों के नाम सुनिए, जिन्हें वे देख पा रहे हैं।
hi.meaning: अर्जुन कहते हैं, ग्यारह रुद्र, बारह आदित्य, आठ वसु, बारह साध्यगण, विश्वेदेव, दो अश्विनीकुमार, उनचास मरुद्गण, उष्मपाः तथा गन्धर्व, यक्ष, असुर और सिद्धों के समुदाय, ये सभी आश्चर्यचकित होकर आपको वीक्षन्ते।
hi.notice: विस्मिताः शब्द का अर्थ है आश्चर्यचकित। रुद्र से लेकर असुरों तक, सभी उच्च प्राणी कृष्ण के रूप को देखकर विस्मित हैं और आपको वीक्षन्ते।
hi.next: अर्जुन कहते हैं कि वे स्वयं भी उस विशाल रूप के अनेक मुख और भयंकर दंशन देखकर कांप रहे हैं।

en.intro: Arjuna is still staring at the cosmic form. Listen to every class of being he names, and notice who is looking and who is not.
en.body: The eleven Rudras, the twelve Adityas, the eight Vasus, the twelve Sadhyas, the Visvedevas, the two Ashvins, the forty-nine Maruts, the ancestors, and the hosts of Gandharvas, Yakshas, Asuras, and Siddhas all gaze at you in wonder. The word vispmitah means astonished. Even the highest beings, from Rudras to Asuras, are left staring in wonder at Krishna, unable to look away. Arjuna then admits that he himself is shaken by the many mouths and terrible fangs he sees in the vision.

hi.body: अर्जुन कहते हैं, ग्यारह रुद्र, बारह आदित्य, आठ वसु, बारह साध्यगण, विश्वेदेव, दो अश्विनीकुमार, उनचास मरुद्गण, उष्मपाः तथा गन्धर्व, यक्ष, असुर और सिद्धों के समुदाय, ये सभी आश्चर्यचकित होकर आपको वीक्षन्ते। विस्मिताः शब्द का अर्थ है आश्चर्यचकित। रुद्र से लेकर असुरों तक, सभी उच्च प्राणी कृष्ण के रूप को देखकर विस्मित हैं और आपको वीक्षन्ते। अर्जुन कहते हैं कि वे स्वयं भी उस विशाल रूप के अनेक मुख और भयंकर दंशन देखकर कांप रहे हैं।

issues: meaning_changed: "दस विश्वेदेव" (The source word is विश्वे (the Visvedevas) and the fixed English translation says 'the Visvedevas'. The Hindi translation says 'दस विश्वेदेव' (ten Visvedevas), which adds a specific number (ten) not found in the source Sanskrit word or the fixed English translation.)

meaning_changed: "सात पितृगण" (The source word is उष्मपाः (ancestors) and the fixed English translation says 'the ancestors'. The Hindi translation says 'सात पितृगण' (seven ancestors/Pitris), which adds a specific number (seven) not found in the source Sanskrit word or the fixed English translation.)

unsupported: "देख रहे हैं" (The source Sanskrit and the fixed English translation say 'look upon' (वीक्षन्ते). The Hindi translation says 'देख रहे हैं' (are looking), which changes the meaning from looking upon in wonder to a continuous, active act of looking, dropping the specific sense of gazing in wonder.)
